40023050.author: पदार्थः
40023050.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, सेनापतिं the commander, प्राप्तं arrived, भरतं Bharata, केकयाधिपः the king of Kekaya, युधाजिद्गार्ग्यसहितं accompanied by Yudhajit and Gargya, परां great, प्रीतिम् joy, उपागमत् attained.

40023050.author: Translation
40023050.content: Having heard that Commander Bharata had arrived, the King of Kekaya, accompanied by Yudhajit and Gargya, attained great joy.

40023051.author: पदार्थः
40023051.content: सः he, निर्ययौ went out, जनौघेन with a multitude of people, महता great, केकयाधिपः the king of Kekaya, त्वरमाणो hurrying, अभिचक्राम approached, गन्धर्वान् the Gandharvas, कामरूपिणः who could change their form at will.

40023051.author: Translation
40023051.content: The King of Kekaya went out with a great multitude of people, hurrying to approach the Gandharvas who could change their form at will.

40023052.author: पदार्थः
40023052.content: भरतश्च Bharata and, युधाजिच्च Yudhajit and, समेतौ together, लघुविक्रमैः with swift warriors, गन्धर्वनगरं to the city of the Gandharvas, प्राप्तौ arrived, सबलौ with their army, सपदानुगौ with their followers.

40023052.author: Translation
40023052.content: Bharata and Yudhajit, accompanied by swift warriors, arrived together at the city of the Gandharvas with their army and followers.

40023053.author: पदार्थः
40023053.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु indeed, भरतम् Bharata, प्राप्तम् arrived, गन्धर्वाः the Gandharvas, ते those, समागताः assembled, योद्धुकामाः desirous of fighting, महावीर्याः of great valor, व्यनदन् roared, वै indeed, समन्ततः all around.

40023053.author: Translation
40023053.content: Having heard of Bharata's arrival, those mighty Gandharvas, eager to fight, assembled and roared from all directions.

40023054.author: पदार्थः
40023054.content: ततः then, समभवत् occurred, युद्धम् a battle, तुमुलम् tumultuous, रोमहर्षणम् hair-raising, सप्तरात्रम् for seven nights, महाभीमम् exceedingly dreadful, न not, च and, अन्यतरयोः of either of the two, जयः victory.

40023054.author: Translation
40023054.content: Then, a tumultuous, hair-raising, and exceedingly dreadful battle ensued for seven nights, with neither side achieving victory.

40023055.author: पदार्थः
40023055.content: खड्ग swords, शक्ति spears, धनुः bows, ग्राहाः (like) alligators, नद्यः rivers, शोणित blood, संस्रवाः flowing, नृकलेवर human corpses, वाहिन्यः carrying, प्रवृत्ताः flowed, सर्वतोदिशम् in all directions.

40023055.author: Translation
40023055.content: Rivers of flowing blood, carrying human corpses and resembling streams with swords, spears, and bows as their aquatic creatures, flowed in all directions.

40023056.author: पदार्थः
40023056.content: ततः then, रामानुजः Rama's younger brother, क्रुद्धः enraged, कालस्य of Time, अस्त्रम् weapon, सुदारुणम् exceedingly terrible, संवर्तम् Samvarta, नाम named, भरतः Bharata, गन्धर्वेषु upon the Gandharvas, अभ्यचोदयत् discharged.

40023056.author: Translation
40023056.content: Then, the enraged Bharata, Rama's younger brother, discharged the exceedingly terrible weapon of Time, named Samvarta, upon the Gandharvas.

40023057.author: पदार्थः
40023057.content: ते they, बद्धाः bound, कालपाशेन by the noose of Time, संवर्तेन by Samvarta, विदारिताः torn apart, क्षणेन in a moment, अभिहताः struck down, तेन by him, तिस्रः three, कोट्यः crores, महात्मनाम् of mighty ones.

40023057.author: Translation
40023057.content: Bound by the noose of Time and torn apart by the Samvarta weapon, three crores of those mighty Gandharvas were instantly struck down by Bharata.

40023058.author: पदार्थः
40023058.content: तं that, घातं destruction, घोरसङ्काशं terrible-looking, न not, स्मरन्ति remember, दिवौकसः gods, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण within the mere twinkling of an eye, तादृशानाम् of such, महात्मनाम् great souls.

40023058.author: Translation
40023058.content: The gods do not even remember that terrible destruction of those great souls (Gandharvas), as it occurred within the mere twinkling of an eye.

40023059.author: पदार्थः
40023059.content: हतेषु having been killed, तेषु those, सर्वेषु all, भरतः Bharata, केकयीसुतः son of Kaikeyi, निवेशयामास established, तदा then, समृद्धे prosperous, द्वे two, पुरोत्तमे excellent cities.

40023059.author: Translation
40023059.content: After all those (Gandharvas) were killed, Bharata, the son of Kaikeyi, then established two prosperous and excellent cities.

40023060.author: पदार्थः
40023060.content: तक्षं Taksha (son of Bharata), तक्षशिलायां in Takshashila, तु and, पुष्कलम् Pushkala (son of Bharata), पुष्कलावते in Pushkalavati, गन्धर्वदेशे in the land of Gandharvas, रुचिरे beautiful, गान्धारविषये in the region of Gandhara, च and, सः he (Bharata).

40023060.author: Translation
40023060.content: He (Bharata) established Taksha in Takshashila and Pushkala in Pushkalavati, both in the beautiful land of Gandharvas, which is the region of Gandhara.

40023061.author: पदार्थः
40023061.content: धनरत्नौघसङ्कीर्णे filled with heaps of wealth and jewels, काननैरुपशोभिते adorned with forests, अन्योन्यसङ्घर्षकृते causing mutual rivalry, स्पर्धया with competition, गुणविस्तरैः with extensive qualities.

40023061.author: Translation
40023061.content: These cities were filled with heaps of wealth and jewels, adorned with forests, and their extensive qualities caused mutual rivalry and competition.

40023062.author: पदार्थः
40023062.content: उभे both, सुरुचिरप्रख्ये very beautiful in appearance, व्यवहारैरकिल्बिषैः with blameless transactions, उद्यानयानसम्पूर्णे full of gardens and conveyances, सुविभक्तान्तरापणे with well-divided inner markets.

40023062.author: Translation
40023062.content: Both cities were very beautiful in appearance, characterized by blameless transactions, full of gardens and conveyances, and had well-divided inner markets.

40023063.author: पदार्थः
40023063.content: उभे both, पुरवरे excellent cities, रम्ये beautiful, विस्तरैः with extensive areas, उपशोभिते adorned, गृहमुख्यैः with principal houses, सुरुचिरैः very charming, विमानसमवर्णिभिः resembling celestial chariots in appearance.

40023063.author: Translation
40023063.content: Both beautiful and excellent cities were adorned with extensive areas, featuring principal houses that were very charming and resembled celestial chariots.

40023064.author: पदार्थः
40023064.content: शोभिते adorned, शोभनीयैः with beautiful ones, च and, देवायतनविस्तरैः with extensive temples, तालैः with palm trees, तमालैः with tamala trees, तिलकैर with tilaka trees, वकुलैः with vakula trees, उपशोभिते adorned.

40023064.author: Translation
40023064.content: The cities were further adorned with beautiful and extensive temples, as well as with palm, tamala, tilaka, and vakula trees.

40023065.author: पदार्थः
40023065.content: निवेश्य having established, पञ्चभिः by five, वर्षैः years, भरतः Bharata, राघवानुजः Rama's younger brother, पुनरायात् returned, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, केकयीसुतः Kaikeyi's son.

40023065.author: Translation
40023065.content: After establishing the cities over a period of five years, Bharata, the mighty-armed son of Kaikeyi and younger brother of Rama, returned to Ayodhya.

40023066.author: पदार्थः
40023066.content: सः he, अभिवाद्य having saluted, महात्मानम् the great-souled one, साक्षात् directly, धर्मम् Dharma, इव like, अपरम् another, राघवम् Rama, भरतः Bharata, श्रीमान् the glorious, ब्रह्माणम् Brahma, इव like, वासवः Indra.

40023066.author: Translation
40023066.content: The glorious Bharata, like Indra saluting Brahma, saluted the great-souled Rama, who was like another embodiment of Dharma itself.

40023067.author: पदार्थः
40023067.content: शशंस he reported, च and, यथावृत्तम् the full account, गन्धर्ववधम् the slaying of the Gandharvas, उत्तमम् excellent, निवेशनम् the establishment, च and, देशस्य of the region, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रीतः pleased, अस्य his, राघवः Rama.

40023067.author: Translation
40023067.content: Bharata reported the full account of the excellent slaying of the Gandharvas and the establishment of the region, and upon hearing this, Rama was pleased with him. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। 101 ।। Thus ends the hundred and first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
